keys.arrowsAfterOperator: Arrow keys after = ( , or an operator
keys.clickOtherSheetTab: Click another sheet's tab while typing a formula
keys.clickThenShiftClick: Click, then Shift + click, while a formula wants a reference
keys.dragFreezeBar: Drag the bar at the corner of the headers
keys.dragHeader: Drag a selected row or column header
title: Keyboard shortcuts
what.addToSelection: Add another cell, range, row, or column to the selection
what.aiAssistant: Open or close the AI assistant (Escape in it goes back to the sheet)
what.autoSum: AutoSum the numbers above or to the left
what.copyFormulaAbove: Copy the formula from the cell above
what.copyValueAbove: Copy the value from the cell above
what.countUpOrRepeat: Count a single number up, or repeat a series instead of continuing it
what.createTable: Create a table from the data around the active cell
what.cycleAnchors: Cycle $ anchors on the reference at the caret
what.duplicateObject: Duplicate the selected chart, image, or text box
what.editInPlace: Edit in place (double-click a cell too)
what.endMode: Jump to the edge of the data (End Mode); End, then Home: the last cell
what.extendOrAdd: Extend the selection / add to the selection with the arrows and clicks
what.findNext: Find the next match / open Find
what.formatCells: Format cells dialog (number, alignment, font, border, fill)
what.formulaBar: Expand or collapse the formula bar
what.freezeByDragging: Freeze rows or columns up to where it lands
what.goTo: Go to a cell, range, named range, table, or Sheet!A1 on another sheet (the name box; Alt + Down there lists the names)
what.groupUngroup: Group / ungroup the selected rows (or columns)
what.highlightReferences: Highlight the cells a formula reads / the formulas that read this cell (Escape clears)
what.insertFunction: Insert function (search every function, or ask the AI for one)
what.jumpToEdge: Jump to the edge of the data
what.keyTips: Show key tips on the ribbon: type a tab’s letter, then a command’s (Escape steps back)
what.moveRightLeft: Move right / left (Tab from the last cell of a table adds a row)
what.nameManager: Name Manager / Create names from the selection
what.nextArea: Next / previous area: menus, toolbar, formula bar, grid, find bar and open panes, sheets, status, assistant
what.nextCorner: Move the active cell to the next corner of the selection
what.nextSheet: Next / previous sheet (also {mod} + Page Down / Page Up)
what.nextSheetMac: Next / previous sheet (also ⌃ or ⌘ + Page Down / Page Up)
what.nudgeObject: Nudge the selected chart, image, or text box 8px, or a whole cell ({mod} + C copies it as a picture, Enter edits it, Delete removes it, Escape deselects)
what.numberFormats: Number / time / date / currency / percent / scientific format
what.openDropdown: Open a dropdown list, a calendar on a date cell, or pick from the column’s entries
what.openLink: Open a link (a link to a sheet or range jumps there)
what.openMenu: Open the menu for the selected cells, or for the focused sheet tab
what.paintFormat: Copy formatting onto other cells: select them with the pointer, or move there and press Enter (Escape cancels)
what.pasteName: Paste a defined name into the cell or the formula being typed
what.pickDate: Pick a date from a calendar
what.pickOnOtherSheet: Pick references there (Sheet2!B3); Enter or Escape comes back
what.pickRange: Pick a cell, then stretch it into a range (dragging works too); {mod} + click adds another after a comma
what.pickReference: Pick a cell reference into the formula (Shift extends to a range)
what.recalculate: Recalculate every formula (NOW(), TODAY(), and RAND() included)
what.refresh: Refresh the query table or PivotTable here / refresh everything
what.repeat: Repeat the last action (in a formula: cycle $ anchors)
what.replaceContents: Replace the cell contents (matching text from the column is suggested)
what.scrollToActiveCell: Scroll back to the active cell
what.searchMenus: Search the menus: every action by name
what.selectColumn: Select the column (in a table, its data first, then with its header)
what.selectCurrentRegion: Select the current region: the block of data around the active cell
what.selectDifferences: Select the row differences / column differences
what.selectNextObject: Select the next chart, image, or text box (Shift: the previous one)
what.selectPrecedentsDependents: Select the precedents / dependents of the active cell
what.selectRow: Select the row (in a table, its row first)
what.switchEnterEditMode: Switch between Enter mode (arrows leave the cell) and Edit mode (arrows move the caret); the status bar shows which
what.toggleRibbon: Show or hide the ribbon’s commands
